  • Airspace: Civil airports reported closed across Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Commercial flights sharply reduced.
  • Diplomacy & mediation: Pakistan mediating. US says ready to discuss but will respond to violence. US domestic politics: Senate Republicans rejected a war‑powers resolution.
  • Operational note: This is another cycle of strike–retaliation. IRGC strikes on US regional assets increase risk of wider Gulf escalation and targeting of shipping lanes.
  • 🟢 Good News: US/Israel strikes confirmed quickly (demonstrates capability). Israel–Lebanon framework signed — first formal step toward de‑escalation on the northern front.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
